title: Separate winback coaching from recipient email copy

source.ref: Owner AI coaching direction and legacy winback audit, 2026-10-26

detail: Winback proposal generation persists only the existing human-written operational template with server-owned provenance. AI is an explicit authenticated operator review returning ephemeral questions without recipient identity/history or proposal writes. Older unattributed/model or edited payloads are blocked before approval and again before execution; they remain available for dismissal rather than silently rewritten. Approval, suppression, unsubscribe and current send consent remain required. Question-shape validation is not a semantic guarantee; isolation from proposal/send paths is the structural boundary. Existing bounded candidate reads and targeting semantics are unchanged. Source and inert-IO verification only; no live email, database mutation or authenticated production review performed.

verify.evidence: 16 focused tests plus actual-source inert-IO probe verify no model copy persistence/send, privacy, usage guards and existing approval/send-consent gates.
